AO_POPUP_QUESTION: Change the offset from {0} ms to {1} ms?
DESC_ER_ALL_DECORATIONS: Clears the decoration list outright, not only the events that place them.
DESC_ER_BACKGROUND: Custom backgrounds, including the background video.
DESC_ER_CAMERA: Camera pans and zooms. Changes what you can see, not just how it looks.
DESC_ER_CAMERA_ZOOM: Replaces the level's camera settings with a fixed zoom.
DESC_ER_CHECKPOINT: Checkpoint events. No Checkpoint does the same without touching the level.
DESC_ER_DECORATIONS: Sprites, text and objects placed over the level.
DESC_ER_DEFAULT_TRACK_ANIMATION: Fade in and out, eight beats ahead.
DESC_ER_FILTER: Flash, bloom, screen shake, hall of mirrors, tiling and scrolling.
DESC_ER_FRAME_RATE: Events that drive the frame rate for effect.
DESC_ER_HIDE: The Hide event. Removing it puts back whatever the level was hiding.
DESC_ER_HIT_SOUND: Per-tile hitsounds and one-off sounds. Timing cues, so off by default.
DESC_ER_REPEAT_EVENTS: The event that replays other events. Also stops it repeating anything left.
DESC_ER_SCRIPTING: AddComponent and CallMethod, which exist to drive the above.
DESC_ER_TRACK_OPACITY: Puts every faded tile back to solid.
DESC_KVE_ALL_COUNTS: Sets every key back to zero.
DESC_KVE_AUTO_Y_CORRECTION: Align the note track to the layout's top edge like DM Note.
DESC_KVE_BEZIER: Four comma-separated cubic Bezier values: x1,y1,x2,y2.
DESC_KVE_COUNTER_MOTION: Pop the number on each press.
DESC_KVE_CSS_METADATA: Stored for DM Note round-tripping. Unity does not execute arbitrary CSS selectors.
DESC_KVE_CUSTOM_CSS: Preserve DM Note CSS with this layout.
DESC_KVE_CUSTOM_CSS_STORE: CSS is stored as compatibility metadata; supported visual settings use native controls above.
DESC_KVE_DELAYED_NOTE: Use DM Note's short-note delay and length policy.
DESC_KVE_ENABLE_COUNTER: Show how many times this key was pressed.
DESC_KVE_ENABLE_SHADOW: Soft drop shadow behind the key.
DESC_KVE_FADE_FAR: Softens notes as they leave the track.
DESC_KVE_FADE_NEAR: Softens notes as they meet the key.
DESC_KVE_FONT_SIZE: Used by keys that do not set their own.
DESC_KVE_GRADIENT_STOPS: Use 2–8 stops in position:#RRGGBBAA form, separated by semicolons.
DESC_KVE_INLINE_STYLES: Records whether DM Note property styles override its custom CSS.
DESC_KVE_KNOB_AXIS: DM Note HIDA values are preserved. A Unity Input Manager axis name can be read directly.
DESC_KVE_LABEL: Empty shows the key's own name.
DESC_KVE_MINIMUM_LENGTH: So a tap is still visible.
DESC_KVE_MULTI_KEYS: Comma-separated key names; up to eight keys per element.
DESC_KVE_NOTE_EFFECT: Pressed notes grow away from the key.
DESC_KVE_OFFSET_X: Distance in from the anchored edge. Negative values push past it instead.
DESC_KVE_PRESET: Replaces the layout with a DM Note export.
DESC_KVE_PRESSED_SCALE: How far a key shrinks while held.
DESC_KVE_REVERSE: Travel below the key instead of above it.
DESC_KVE_SHOW_COUNTERS: Master switch for every key's press count.
DESC_KVE_SHOW_NOTES: Master switch for every key's note trail.
DESC_KVE_TRANSPARENT_ACTIVE: Draw only the label while held.
DESC_KVE_TRANSPARENT_IDLE: Draw only the label while idle.
DESC_LANGUAGE: Text for this mod's interface. Files live in UserData/HemiTweaks/Lang — add one to add a language.
DESC_LANGUAGE_RELOAD: Re-reads every language file from disk.
DESC_PREF_ACTIVE_PROFILE: Writes the current settings into this profile.
DESC_PREF_FONT_SIZE: Scales every label and row in this interface.
DESC_PREF_OPEN_INTERFACE: Esc cancels while a key is being captured.
DESC_PREF_SMOOTH_SCROLLING: Ease scroll movement instead of jumping.
DESC_PREF_UPDATE_ON_STARTUP: Looks at the GitHub releases once when the game starts and shows a card if a newer build exists.
DESC_PREF_UPDATE_TOKEN: Only needed while the repository is private. Leave empty otherwise.
DESC_SET_AUTOOFFSET_CURRENT: For {0}. Type a value and press Enter. Positive means later.
DESC_SET_AUTOOFFSET_DECIMAL: Lets the offset carry a fraction of a millisecond. The game's own setting shows it too and keeps the rounded value.
DESC_SET_AUTOOFFSET_POPUP: After a death, asks whether to change the offset to what the run measured. Restarting past the popup means no.
DESC_SET_AUTOOFFSET_POPUP_OFFSET: Distance from the centre of the screen. The popup can also be dragged in the overlay editor.
DESC_SET_AUTOOFFSET_POPUP_SCALE: Size of the whole card, text and buttons included.
DESC_SET_AUTOOFFSET_RECORD: When a run ends by death, pause or clear, its average timing is kept below so it can be applied later.
DESC_SET_BUILDNAME_NAME: Shown where the game prints its build string.
DESC_SET_COMBO_FADE: Hidden until the combo goes up; then it fades in, stays, and fades out. The pulse still plays.
DESC_SET_COMBO_FADE_HOLD: How long it stays fully visible before fading out.
DESC_SET_COMBO_OFFSET: Distance inward from the anchored edge. Negative values push past it instead.
DESC_SET_COMBO_PULSE_SIZE: How much bigger the number gets when it changes. Zero turns the pulse off.
DESC_SET_COMBO_PULSE_TIME: Seconds from the punch back to rest.
DESC_SET_COMBO_SHADOW_COLOR: Fully transparent, or both offsets at zero, turns the shadow off.
DESC_SET_COMBO_SHADOW_X: Offset relative to the text size, not in pixels.
DESC_SET_COMBO_SIZE: The word sits at a little over half this.
DESC_SET_EFFECTREMOVER_BLOCK_SAVE: Refuse to save while effects are hidden. Turning this off lets you save a level with the effects actually removed, which is permanent.
DESC_SET_EFFECTREMOVER_CAMERA_ZOOM: Used only while the override above is on.
DESC_SET_HIDEUI_AUTOPLAY: The autoplay text, and the editor's Otto button.
DESC_SET_HIDEUI_ERRORMETER: The hit timing bar under the planets.
DESC_SET_HIDEUI_LEVELTITLE: The song name and composer shown as a level starts.
DESC_SET_HIDEUI_NOFAIL: The modifier icon. The key limiter icon beside it stays.
DESC_SET_OVERLOADBAR_OFFSET: Distance inward from the anchored edge. Negative values push past it instead.
DESC_SET_OVERLOADBAR_SHOW_REST: Draws the rest of the bar behind the part that moves.
DESC_SET_PLANETCOLOR_OVERLAY_ENABLE: Draw a picture over each planet.
DESC_SET_PROGRESSBAR_OFFSET: Distance inward from the anchored edge. Negative values push past it instead.
DESC_SET_PROGRESSBAR_OUTLINE_TOGGLE: Traces the filled part of the bar.
DESC_SET_PROGRESSBAR_SHOW_REST: Draws the part of the bar still to come.
DESC_SET_PROGRESSBAR_WIDTH: 1920 is the full width of the screen.
DESC_SET_TILEINFO_ANGLE: Total rotation across the selection, in degrees.
DESC_SET_TILEINFO_BEATS: Length of the selection in beats.
DESC_SET_TILEINFO_EXCLUDE_LAST: Measures 4→8 rather than 4→9 when tiles 4 to 8 are selected. The tile count is unaffected.
DESC_SET_TILEINFO_SECONDS: Length of the selection in seconds, at the chart's own speed.
DESC_SET_TILEINFO_SHADOW_COLOR: Fully transparent, or both offsets at zero, turns the shadow off.
DESC_SET_TILEINFO_SHADOW_X: Offset relative to the text size, not in pixels.
DESC_SET_TILEINFO_SIZE: Relative to the tile number the reading replaces.
DESC_SET_TUF_OPEN_BROWSER: Opens the TUF browser straight from the game.
DESC_STATE_COLOR: Stats without their own colour use this.
DESC_STATE_ENTRANCE: Slides in from off screen when a run starts, on one of the game's own easing curves.
DESC_STATE_EXIT: Slides off screen when the level is failed or cleared.
DESC_STATE_HORIZONTAL: Place stats side by side instead of stacked.
DESC_STATE_PLAYING_ONLY: Off keeps this on screen in menus and the editor too.
DESC_STATE_REMOVE_RICH_TEXT: Shows the level's own text as written, on one line.
DESC_STATE_SEPARATOR: Sits between the prefix and the value.
DESC_STATE_SHADOW_COLOR: Fully transparent, or both offsets at zero, turns the shadow off.
DESC_STATE_SHADOW_X: Offset relative to the text size, not in pixels.
DESC_STATE_X_OFFSET: Distance in from the anchored edge. Negative values push past it instead.
ER_SAVE_BLOCKED: Saving is off while Effect Remover is hiding effects.
FEATURE_AUTOOFFSET_SUMMARY: Work out the input offset from how you hit, and apply it.
FEATURE_BUILDNAME_SUMMARY: Change the build text the game shows.
FEATURE_COMBO_SUMMARY: A combo counter that reacts to every hit.
FEATURE_EFFECTREMOVER_SUMMARY: Hide a level's decorations, filters and screen effects.
FEATURE_HIDEUI_SUMMARY: Hide parts of the game's own HUD.
FEATURE_KEYVIEWER_SUMMARY: Show the keys you press, with counters and note rain.
FEATURE_NOCHECKPOINT_SUMMARY: Ignore checkpoints, so a failed run restarts from the beginning.
FEATURE_NONSCROLL_SUMMARY: Stop the mouse wheel zooming the camera while playing.
FEATURE_OVERLOADBAR_SUMMARY: How close the tile density is to overloading.
FEATURE_PLANETCOLOR_SUMMARY: Recolour the planets, rings and tails.
FEATURE_PROGRESSBAR_SUMMARY: How far through the level you are.
FEATURE_STATE_SUMMARY: On-screen counters and readouts while you play.
FEATURE_TILECORNER_SUMMARY: Round the corners where tiles meet.
FEATURE_TILEINFO_SUMMARY: Angle, beats, count and seconds on the tiles you select.
FEATURE_TUF_SUMMARY: Search and download levels from TUF.
FEATURE_UNLOCKLIMITS_SUMMARY: Remove editor and settings value restrictions.
KVE_NOTE_CANVAS: Select a key on the canvas to edit it. Ctrl or Shift click adds to the selection, and dragging empty space sweeps one — edits then apply to every selected key. The middle or right button drags the view.
KVE_NOTE_COUNTERS_OFF: Counters are off for every key. Turn them on under Counters with nothing selected.
KVE_NOTE_DM_NOTE: Imports DM Note keys, stats, graphs, knobs, layers, visual styles, counters, and note settings. Raw HID knob input and arbitrary CSS are preserved as metadata when Unity cannot execute them directly.
KVE_NOTE_OVERLAY_AREA: The area is whatever the keys and their notes take up — there is no size to set, and it follows the layout as it is edited. The anchor and offset below decide where that area sits on screen, which is what keeps it put across resolutions.
KVE_NOTE_STAT: KPS counts presses per second across every key; Total adds up their press counts.

PREF_PROFILE_NOTE: A profile stores every mod setting. Switching one writes its files back and reloads them.
SET_AUTOOFFSET_DECIMAL_NOTE: In the game's pause menu the offset arrows now step by 10 ms, 1 ms with Shift, 0.1 ms with Ctrl and 0.01 ms with Ctrl+Shift.
SET_AUTOOFFSET_NOTE: The average is taken over hits that landed inside the judgement window; misses, autoplay and replays are left out. Positive means you hit late, so the offset goes up.
SET_AUTOOFFSET_NO_RECORDS: No runs recorded yet. Play a level with the feature on and fail, pause or clear it.
SET_AUTOOFFSET_RUN: This run so far: {0} hits, average {1} ms.
SET_BUILDNAME_NOTE: Turning the feature off restores the game's own text immediately.
SET_COMBO_FADE: Fade in and out on change
SET_COMBO_KIND_NOTE: Perfect: the three perfects keep it, whether or not absolute perfect is switched on. X-Combo: absolute perfect only. Combo: every landed hit — the perfects, early, late, very early and very late; only a miss, an overload, too early or too late ends it.
SET_COMBO_NOTE: Counts hits of the chosen kind in a row; any other judgement drops it to zero. Auto and midspin tiles are stepped over rather than breaking it.
SET_EFFECTREMOVER_BLOCK_SAVE_NOTE: With this on, Save, Save As and Ctrl+S are all refused in the editor and their buttons are greyed out.
SET_EFFECTREMOVER_GAMEPLAY_NOTE: These change more than how the level looks, so they start off.
SET_EFFECTREMOVER_RELOAD_NOTE: Reload the level after changing anything here — a level already open keeps whatever was decided when it was read.
SET_EFFECTREMOVER_WHAT_NOTE: The chosen events are dropped from the level after the game reads it. The level file is never written to.
SET_HIDEUI_NOTE: Turning the feature off shows everything again. The level title and autoplay text use the game's own switches for this, so they come back exactly as they were.
SET_NOCHECKPOINT_NOTE_ICON: Checkpoint tiles keep their icon, so you can still see where the chart put them.
SET_NOCHECKPOINT_NOTE_MODES: Speed trial and practice mode already ignore checkpoints, so this changes nothing there.
SET_NOCHECKPOINT_NOTE_STAT: The Checkpoints stat stays at zero while this is on, because none are used.
SET_NOCHECKPOINT_WHAT_NOTE: Checkpoints stop working: reaching one no longer revives anyone, and failing sends you back to the start of the level instead of to the last checkpoint.
SET_OVERLOADBAR_NOTE: Overload is what kills a run that presses too often. The counter rises with every miss and falls back on its own; the bar is full at the point it would kill you. With No Fail on it still moves, but nothing comes of it.
SET_PLANETCOLOR_OVERLAY_NOTE: A relative path is read from the folder of the level being played, so a level can ship its own images.
SET_PROGRESSBAR_SOURCE_NOTE: Tiles is the same figure as the Progress stat, so it steps once per tile. Song time follows the music instead, which moves smoothly between them.
SET_TILECORNER_NOTE: Corners are rounded where two floors meet at a supported angle. The level file is never modified.
SET_TILEINFO_NOTE: The reading replaces the tile's number badge on the first selected tile, and shows even with tile numbers turned off. Clearing the selection puts the number back.
SET_TUF_GUEST_NOTE: TUF is somebody else's server. Searches wait until you stop typing, repeated queries are answered from memory, and only one download runs at a time.
SET_UNLOCKLIMITS_COVERS_NOTE: Editor property ranges, practice speed, editor playback speed, and ranged settings values all lose their upper and lower bounds.
SET_UNLOCKLIMITS_WARNING_NOTE: Values outside the normal range can produce level data the game cannot play back. Saving a level while a value is out of range keeps that value in the file.
STATE_DELETE_GROUP_CONFIRM: Delete group '{0}'? Its stats and style are removed permanently.
STATE_GROUP_EMPTY: This group is empty, so nothing is drawn for it.
STATE_NO_GROUPS: No groups yet. Add one to start showing values on screen.
